notes.title: Update Patch v1.0.3
notes.content:
- Code Improvements to prevent bugs in Dialogue System
- Gravity Anomaly: Upgrading Endurance now has more effect on escaping gravity pull
- Improved Large Energy Crystal Particle Effects
- Added some more hidden objects to be detectable with advanced vision
- Fixed Crate Items Spawn Bug

notes.title: Update Patch v1.0.2
notes.content:
Small Update with some improvements:

- Code changes to prevent possible crashes
- Bugfix: Mission Objectives were not correctly saved, if game gets saved before activation.

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
Based on feedback from players I just released an update with some improvements:

- Improved Game Balance: Reduced gravity anomaly force pull during enabled speed mode
- Puzzle UI Navigation now also works with arrow keys
- Removed collision from energy crystals shards to prevent accidental collision with player
- Improved Performance by enabling Nanite on some meshes inside cave section of game

notes.title: The Journey starts ...
notes.content:
This is the beginning of the journey to create a unique scifi experience for space and scifi nerds like myself and I'm happy the steam page is finally live!

Now begins the part which is the most rewarding and fun: Creating a Demo and finishing the game. The focus of development will be interesting gameplay mechanics, a good story and an atmospheric planet for the player to discover.

I hope you are as excited as I am. Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions or feedback. I am also open to people playtesting the game in a couple of weeks.

Also: It would be appreciated, if you wishlist the game if you haven't done so already. It helps a lot!

See you soon!

- Ralph
